scenes.text: Hello, little explorers! I'm Mino, your friendly space adventurer. Today, we're going on a fun journey to discover all about screen time. Are you ready to zoom into the stars and learn something new? Together, we'll explore how to use screens wisely and why it's important. So, buckle up your space helmets, and let's get started on this exciting adventure!

Now, let's think about what screen time is. Screen time is the time we spend looking at screens like tablets, TVs, or computers. Just like we have time to play with toys or read books, we also need to manage our screen time. It's fun to watch cartoons or play games, but too much screen time isn't always good for us. It's important to balance our time so we can enjoy many different activities every day.

Remember when we talked about balance? Let's learn how to balance screen time with other activities. For example, after watching a fun show, we can play outside or draw a picture. It's like having a yummy meal with different foods on your plate. Each activity helps us grow and learn in different ways. So, let's make sure we have time for all the fun things we love to do!

Great job, little adventurers! Now, would you like to try a fun exercise with me? Let's pretend we're astronauts flying through space. We'll count to five like we're jumping from star to star. Ready? One, two, three, four, five! Fantastic! Just like counting stars, we can count how much time we spend on screens. This helps us remember to do other fun things too!

Now that we know how to balance, let's talk about why it's important to take breaks from screens. Our eyes and brains need rest so we can stay healthy and happy. When we take breaks, we can stretch, move around, or even dance to our favorite songs. It's like giving our bodies a little vacation from screens. Taking breaks helps us feel more energized and ready for our next adventure!

Let's learn how to set a timer for screen time. Setting a timer is like having a friendly reminder to take a break. We can use a kitchen timer or ask an adult to help us. When the timer goes off, it's time to do something different, like build a puzzle or read a story. This way, we can enjoy screens and still have time for other exciting adventures!

You're doing amazing, little explorers! Let's count together again, but this time, let's count the different activities we can do today. There's playing with toys, drawing, reading, and so much more. Ready? One, two, three, four, five! Wonderful! See how many fun things we can do? Each activity is like a new planet to explore in our space adventure!

Remember when we talked about taking breaks? Let's talk about some fun things we can do during our breaks. We can go outside and pretend we're astronauts exploring a new planet. Or we can dance to our favorite song like we're floating in space. These activities help us use our imagination and have fun without screens. It's like having a mini space adventure right at home!

Now, let's talk about staying safe while using screens. It's important to have an adult with us when we're online. They can help us make smart choices and keep us safe. Just like wearing a helmet when we ride a bike, having an adult nearby keeps us protected. This way, we can enjoy screen time and feel safe and secure!

Do you have a favorite show or game you like to play? It's fun to have favorites, but remember, variety is the spice of life! What other activities do you enjoy besides screen time? Maybe you like building with blocks or painting. Sharing our favorite activities with friends and family can be lots of fun too! What do you think?

Let's think about how we can use screens to learn new things. Screens can be like our own little classroom in space. We can watch educational videos or play games that teach us about numbers and letters. It's like going on a space mission to discover new things. Learning with screens can be fun, but remember to explore other ways of learning too!

You're doing such a great job, little adventurers! Let's take a moment to celebrate. Give yourself a big hug for being such a smart explorer. Remember, every new thing we learn is like adding a new star to our galaxy. Keep shining bright and exploring new adventures every day!

Now, let's think about how we can plan our screen time. Planning helps us make sure we have time for everything we love. We can make a schedule with time for screens, play, and rest. It's like having a map for our space journey. With a plan, we can enjoy each activity and have a balanced day!

Remember, it's okay to ask for help from an adult when we're planning our day. They can help us make choices that are good for us. Just like we need help tying our shoes, we sometimes need help with screen time. Together, we can make sure our days are filled with fun and learning!

Wow, what an amazing journey we've had today! Thank you for exploring screen time with me, little adventurers. Remember to balance your time, take breaks, and stay safe. Keep discovering new things and having fun every day. Until our next adventure, keep shining bright like the stars! Goodbye for now!
